errors.name: AdminDisabled
errors.description: No administrative credential is configured, so the administrative surface does not exist.

cursor.description: Pass back as cursor for the next page. Absent at the end.
The cursor from the previous page. Encodes the created-at instant and the value together, so an entry added mid-scan can neither appear twice nor be skipped.

main.description: Page through the appview's denylist, newest first. Requires the administrative credential. You cannot operate a list you cannot read: without this, the only way to audit a takedown is to open the database.

kind.description: The kind derived from the value when it was added.

comment.description: The free-text moderation note, if one was given.

createdBy.description: The administrative identifier that added the entry. Never caller-supplied.
